[SWS_CRYPT_02702]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The
ara::crypto::cryp::EncryptorPublic-
Ctx::SetKey
shall check the allowed-usage flags of the key parameter provided. If
kAllowDataEncryption
is not set, a
kUsageViolation
error shall be returned.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02202)
